name: Aegispick
description: Hammer and beak both face outward across the body, so the guard answers a cut with whichever face is nearer.

name: Crowhavoc
description: A light tap of the hammer face opens the guard and sets the beak's next strike.

name: Rumble Drive
description: Just after the hammer lands, the beak pricks into the opening it left.

name: Rampaging Peckhead
description: The haft rolls in the fingers so the hammer and the beak change places midway through one swing.

name: Toxin Puncture
description: The beak catches the foe's pick or hook at the same spot he is reaching for, a mirror of his own move.

name: Equipoise Backbill
description: The hammer face meets a blow and rebounds, and the beak comes round at once to cover the other side.

name: Glintchink
description: The hammer face cracks the plate and the beak enters the crack in the same blow, splitting it open.

name: Hoarfrost Waistpoint
description: The beak hooks an armor edge while the hammer face presses the foe's arm flat, pinning him between the two.

name: Paired Ironthorn
description: Hammer and beak strike as a single field-charged pair and drive through breastplate and backplate together.

name: Flintlike Pickfluke
description: The pick is held high like a hawk's head while the feet flow low like water, ready for either motion.

name: Vengeful Pickhelve
description: A broad, fan-like tap of the spike lands on the target's plate and spreads a qi pulse across it.

name: Vigilant Stonetip
description: The student sights along the haft as a hawk sights along its beak and sees where the foe is weakest.

name: Gust Peck
description: Flat, gliding steps carry the student across the practice floor without a sound.

name: Shattering Hardtooth
description: After dropping on the foe from above, the beak turns in the wound of the plate to widen the hole.

name: Murk Backbill
description: The haft folds the attacking blade into a curve like a river bend and lets it flow harmlessly past.

name: Toxin Spikebeak
description: The beak clamps on a plate like a claw closing and the student drags it aside to expose the lining.

name: Facetcrack
description: Leaping over a gap or a fallen man, the student plunges the beak into the plate below in one stoop.

name: Rumble Crowbill
description: One hand hauls the beak back while the other drives the butt forward, peeling the armor along two tracks.

name: Blinking Punch
description: The student flashes past the foe's guard in a blink of azure qi and drives the spike into the open side.

name: Obdurate Spikebeak
description: The student sinks into the heavy, unmoving stance of a stone laid in the basin floor.

name: Rumble Pickhelve
description: The hammer face taps along the edge of a plate to find where it sounds hollow.

name: Crowvigil
description: A quick count of the rivets along a plate shows how it was built and where it will fail first.

name: Drivehavoc
description: Two hammer blows strike the upper and lower hinge of one plate and crack both together.

name: Mayhem Crack
description: The beak slides into a plate seam and levers it wide for the hammer's next blow.

name: Might Punch
description: A hard azure-charged beat shears three rivets at once, and the plate swings loose.

name: Novapunch
description: The spike falls along the plate's central ridge and halves the breastplate like a split log.

name: Rumble Chink
description: The hammer face rolls blow after blow down one plate in a drumming pattern that spreads the crack.

name: Blaze Peckhead
description: A single stroke of the hammer face carries enough field qi to split breastplate and backplate together.

name: Adamantine Crowbill
description: The pick is held between two lines of attack, the student's weight evenly set on both feet.

name: Downward Stonetip
description: The beak thrusts down the left track of the foe's body, aimed at the shoulder joint.

name: Drive Wrath
description: The hammer face beats down the right track and drives the guard hand away from the foe's helm.

name: Waningfluke
description: The student reads the foe's rank for the thinnest man in the line, where a breach can be opened.

name: Gustchink
description: Quick, flowing steps carry the student diagonally into the gap he has chosen.

name: Gust Waistpoint
description: Feinting down one track, the student switches in mid-swing and hammers the other.

name: Harnessing Crack
description: At the edge of the opening, the beak catches a shield and wrenches it aside to widen the gap.

name: Unbowed Pickfluke
description: The haft is held parallel to the foe's blade and slides along it, guiding the cut off to the side.

name: Peckruin
description: Into the breach the student has made, the spike falls with a burst of qi on the man behind the shield.

name: Rumble Puncture
description: One track pulls the foe's shield down with the beak and the other drops the hammer on his helm.

name: Booming Chink
description: Both tracks of the pick converge in one stroke of field qi that bursts through the front of an armored rank.

name: Granite Hardtooth
description: The student holds a formal, upright posture with the pick across the body, giving the foe no opening to read.

name: Corroding Ironthorn
description: The hammer face drops straight down on a foe's foot or shin, as a stone settles on a basin floor.

name: Ruinous Crowbill
description: The beak probes the edge of a shield or plate in a slow, testing line.

name: Devastating Waistpoint
description: The two faces alternate in a steady rhythm, hammer then beak then hammer, that wears down a guard.

name: Chime Ironthorn
description: The haft sweeps a broad arc in front of the student and fends off blows from either side.

name: Numbing Punch
description: The beak hooks a helmet rim and the student turns his hips, throwing the foe over his leg.

name: Tempered Peck
description: The hammer falls once from overhead with a grave, measured weight and a burst of qi that settles a duel.

name: Ponderous Peck
description: The spike sinks into a plate and the hammer face presses the foe's guard arm down, holding both in place.

name: Unsparing Blaze Chink
description: The hammer face lands with the full weight of field qi and collapses helm and skull guard in one closing blow.

name: Charter Peckhead
description: The student crouches with the pick lifted and still, eyes fixed on one point of the foe's armor.

name: Flukeruin
description: The beak falls on one chosen rivet and leaves a small dent to mark the true target.

name: Pickinsight
description: A single look at the edge of the foe's guard shows how long it will be before he drops it.

name: Phantom Puncture
description: A spread-armed pace to the side, like a hawk tilting a wing, lines the student up beside his mark.

name: Pickscourge
description: The student folds in tight and drops, so the spike lands from a height the foe's guard did not expect.

name: Pickhelve Hardihood
description: The haft sweeps out like a pinion feather and brushes a thrust off its line.

name: Overpowering Pickfluke
description: The beak hooks a foe's mantle or collar and drags him down, ruining his guard.

name: Iron Crack
description: Qi gathers over several breaths along the raised pick, then the spike is driven down with the weight of the sky.

name: Mayhem Backbill
description: The beak clamps a plate in mid-fall and peels it from the body as the student lands.

name: Peckwrath
description: A hawk's full stoop of field qi carries the spike through plate, mail and padding in a single falling thrust.

name: Thorn Stonetip
description: The student stands as one who has sworn on open stone, pick upright and unmoving before him.

name: Crackhavoc
description: The student sets a bearing on the foe before the jab leaves, and the spike travels it unerringly.

name: Veritypick
description: A glance at grass, cloak and banner shows which way the wind will carry the next blow.

name: Toxin Crowbill
description: Having sworn to hold his ground, the student hooks the foe and hauls him in without stepping.

name: Gustcrow
description: The haft meets the blow with the wind behind it, and the cut rolls off to the side.

name: Granite Drive
description: The hammer comes down with the full unyielding weight of the student's oath, denting a helm.

name: Iron Spikebeak
description: The spike falls with a stamp that shakes the stone underfoot and drives through plate and mail.

name: Thorn Ironthorn
description: The beak lodges in a foe's plate and the student holds the haft fast as if by an oath, binding him in place.

name: Punishing Hardtooth Reckoning
description: All the student's sworn resolve is driven into the spike as one thrust of field qi that goes through steel.

name: Hardtooth Nerve
description: Feet spread wide and the pick held along a fixed bearing, the student gives the wind nothing to push against.

name: Rumble Waistpoint
description: The spike is thrust along the line of the wind, so its blow arrives faster than the eye follows.

name: Gust Puncture
description: The hammer face raps a foe's guard arm at the instant a gust blows his cloak across his eyes.

name: Revitalizing Spikebeak
description: The student feels each gust across the open ground and reads from it where the foe's rank is thin.

name: Stonetip Flash
description: With nothing to hem him in, the student steps freely in any direction and keeps the pick between himself and the foe.

name: Enthralling Crack
description: The student turns his bearing a quarter and the hooked beak swings the foe round with him.

name: Flukespine
description: The haft sweeps across the front on a breath of wind and sweeps aside every thrust it meets.

name: Granite Backbill
description: Timed to a gust at his back, the student's hammer blow lands with the wind's weight added.

name: Facet Chink
description: The spike presses slowly and steadily into a seam, held to its line as by a sworn promise.

name: Mayhempick
description: A haul of the beak timed with a strong gust tears an armor plate clean off the foe's chest.

name: Iron Pickhelve
description: The beak is driven down a bearing held unwaveringly true and enters plate at precisely the aimed point.

name: Headlong Hour Punch
description: In a flash of gale qi the student crosses the whole gap along his bearing and the spike lands as he arrives.

name: Aegis Pickfluke
description: The student braces his shoulder into the wind and holds the pick across his body as a firm bar.

name: Punchwrath
description: The hammer face rings on the foe's helm as the gale howls, jarring his sight and his hearing.

name: Illuminating Crowbill
description: The student feels the pick head's weight pull as the wind rises and times his swing to it.

name: Decimating Peck
description: The haft rolls over in the hands as though turned by the wind and the hammer face lands from beneath.

name: Chime Backbill
description: The hammer face meets a blow and rebounds as if thrown back by a gust, snapping up for the counter.

name: Overbearing Stonetip
description: A hammer blow dents a shield rim and the beak sets in the dent, hauling the shield out of line.

name: Tempered Spikebeak
description: A gale of qi gives the hammer face a crushing weight that folds a breastplate inward onto the ribs.

name: Overbearing Punch
description: The hammer face is held pressed against a foe's shoulder while a steady blast of qi pins him where he stands.

name: Shattering Pickhelve
description: All the wind of the plateau is gathered into one stroke of the hammer face that smashes armor and bone together.

name: Pickvalor
description: The student sets a low stance with the beak forward, ready to snag the first strap that offers itself.

name: Iron Pickfluke
description: The beak pricks at a plate's rim until a corner lifts enough to be caught.

name: Testing Hardtooth
description: A glance at straps flapping in the wind shows which are frayed and ready to give.

name: Headlong Waistpoint
description: The student paces round to windward of the foe, so the gusts press against his own back.

name: Mayhem Peckhead
description: The beak's edge saws across a strap in a short hard pull and the plate it held sags away.

name: Unrelenting Ironthorn
description: With a gust against it, the haft turns a cut aside by the width of a hand.

name: Toxin Crack
description: The beak slides under a plate and a rising heave lifts it from the body, exposing the padding.

name: Crackmettle
description: A haul of the beak with a gale of qi behind it strips the plate and its lining from the foe in one pull.

name: Shattering Peck
description: Where plate has just been torn away, the spike drops into the bare padding and meets no resistance.

name: Toxin Peckhead
description: One qi-wind haul strips the plate from the foe's chest and the spike follows through the exposed padding.

name: Ironcrow
description: The student keeps the pick before him and his heels a pace from the drop, never giving back an inch.

name: Tempered Drive
description: A thrust along the line of the plateau's edge pushes the foe toward the lip as the spike lands.

name: Verityfluke
description: The student reads the lip of the plateau underfoot, learning where the stone is solid and where it crumbles.

name: Ironpunch
description: Walking the very edge, the student swings the hammer face from the drop side where the foe does not look.

name: Torrent Pickfluke
description: The haft turns on the rim of the student's shoulder and fends off a charge toward the edge.

name: Chime Punch
description: The beak hooks a foe's belt at the lip and pulls him back from the drop, or down upon it.

name: Peckscourge
description: The spike falls with such a burst of qi that it pierces plate and cracks the stone beneath the foe.

name: Rumble Stonetip
description: The student hooks and heaves with the hammer's weight, tipping the foe's balance out over the lip.

name: Toxin Ironthorn
description: A field-charged hook and hammer blow together hurl the foe bodily beyond the plateau's edge.

name: Hoarfrost Backbill
description: The student plants his feet on a sworn line and sights a bearing along the pick's haft.

name: Hellish Puncture
description: The spike travels a single sworn line from the student's chest to the target and does not stray.

name: Sanguine Waistpoint
description: The hammer face beats along the held bearing and lands exactly where the eye was fixed.

name: Crowinsight
description: A glance picks out the one mark on a foe's armor that the student has sworn to strike.

name: Mayhem Drive
description: The beak catches the foe's weapon arm and holds it, steadfast, until the student's next move is ready.

name: Equipoise Spikebeak
description: The haft stays on its bearing as the foe's blade slides along it and away.

name: Ruinous Hardtooth
description: A breath of wind lifts under the spike at the last instant and slips it up beneath the plate's lower edge.

name: Ruinous Pickhelve
description: The student drives the spike with the weight of his sworn word, and the plate gives way before it.

name: Chinkdurance
description: The beak hooks a foe and the haul runs back along the fixed bearing, leaving no room to resist.

name: Chinkscourge
description: The final thrust of the held bearing carries every sworn mark with it and pierces whatever stands in its line.
